text:
Alex (product): Heads up — Sales just forwarded a customer request from FinOptics. They want Llama4o-v2 pinned for a regulated pilot in eu-west-3 and eu-south-1. Requirements: dedicated SLA, 4-bit quantized variant, version pin for 6 months. cc @Mira (support) @Sam (sales) :eyes:
Sam (sales): Customer expects 150ms tail latency target, ~20 req/s steady, reserved capacity preferred. Need ballpark pricing and timeline by EOW. They can sign a PO for a pilot if we meet region+SLA.
Mira (support): Quick checklist: licensing/export control check, confirm model upstream restrictions. Also ask whether they will send PII or telemetry. KMS + audit logs likely required.
Ravi (infra): Region capacity note: eu-west-3 has spare capacity for small reserved pools. eu-south-1 is new in our infra plan — provisioning lead time ~3-4 weeks unless we re-route to eu-west-3. Autoscale works but dedicated pin requires reserved GPU pool.
Jules (eng-ml): 4-bit quant path exists but we need to validate quality regression vs v2 fp16. I'd recommend a canary rollout plus a 5k-prompt eval set before pin. Also watch KV cache size differences — may affect latency.
Alex (product): Proposed next steps: 1) Sales fills intake form with workload profile (SLA, latency p95/p99 target, dataset examples). 2) Legal/export check. 3) Eng-ML runs quant eval (canary). 4) Infra gives capacity & pricing. 5) PM decision on scope (hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Who owns intake?
Sam (sales): I will own intake and post the filled form today. Can @Ravi give a quick cost delta for a small reserved pool + quant infra?
Ravi (infra): Very rough: reserved pool + network + ops ~ "$12k/mo" extra for a minimal pilot in eu-west-3. eu-south-1 adds provisioning overhead — add 30% until we have firm SKUs. Exact after model footprint.
Mira (support): Please add compliance flags in the intake: data residency, KMS requirement, SOC2/audit retention, retention windows. If customer needs Private deployment (VPC/on-prem), note that timeline jumps.
Jules (eng-ml): If they require private, add ~4-8 weeks for on-prem packaging + security review. For hosted quant canary: I'll run evals, timeline 5 business days once I have sample prompts and a checkpoint.
Alex (product): Danger signals / scope creep: Private deployment, strict export restrictions, or >6 month pin requirement without contract. If any of those, escalate to Enterprise PM.
Sam (sales): Understood. I'll ask FinOptics to confirm private vs hosted and share a small prompt set (500 prompts) by EOD.
Alex (product): Example pin request payload for intake (please paste into the form):
```
model: llama4o-v2
variant: q4_0 (quantized-4bit)
regions: [eu-west-3, eu-south-1]
pin_duration_months: 6
expected_qps: 20
latency_slo_ms: 150 (p99 target)
privacy: KMS + audit-logs + EU-only data residency
```
Sam (sales): Will do.
